# core: Events

Part of [core](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core), PocketBase's Go package `core` as JavaScript sees it. The same types in Go: [core: Events](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/core/events).

## core.RequestEvent

Has everything <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/router#routerevent">router.Event</a></code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|

| `realIP()` | <code>(): string</code> | RealIP returns the "real" IP address from the configured trusted proxy headers. |
| `hasSuperuserAuth()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | HasSuperuserAuth checks whether the current RequestEvent has superuser authentication loaded. |
